dict.string: SUBQUERY( extensionItems, $item, ( $item.attachments.@count > 0 AND $item.attachments.@count <= 20 AND SUBQUERY( $item.attachments, $att, ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.url" OR ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.image" OR ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers == "com.apple.uikit.image" OR ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "com.adobe.pdf" OR ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.movie" OR ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.audio" OR ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.text" OR ANY $att.registeredTypeIdentifiers UTI-CONFORMS-TO "public.content" ).@count == $item.attachments.@count ) OR ( $item.attachments.@count == 0 AND $item.attributedContentText.length > 0 ) ).@count == extensionItems.@count AND extensionItems.@count > 0 AND extensionItems.@count <= 20
